title: Gideon's Three Hundred Defeat Midian
summary: Gideon with 300 men routs Midian; Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna are slain; "the country was in quietness forty years in the days of Gideon" (Judg 6:11–8:28).
description: Judges-period record added from James B. Jordan's chronology (secondary display) with Ussher, Jones and, where available, CFAH-1 Table 1 dates for sorting. Jordan treats the judgeships as partly overlapping regional sequences (North / Centre / South) fitted to the 480 years of 1 Kgs 6:1 and the 300 years of Judg 11:26.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones baseline): 1251 BC (no CFAH anchor point for this event). Jordan (secondary display) never sets the sort.

chronologies.date: 1251 BC (Gideon defeats Oreb and Zeeb of Midian and Amalek)
chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 1: Problem, Data, and Methodology," ARJ 15 (2022): 377–390, section "Our Assumptions (Declared Biases)", Table 1 "Biblically derived dates from Ussher and Jones"
chronologies.note: CFAH-1 Table 1 (Ussher-Jones biblical baseline adopted by CFAH); not a triangulated anchor point.

chronologies.date: "1251 BC GIDEON'S 300 WIN"; GIDEON "40 YRS" 1258 BC to 1218 BC
chronologies.citation: Jones, Chart No. 4 "Judges to the First 3 Kings" (© 1993 Floyd Jones; chart text revised "As of 2007"), timeline band
chronologies.note: Gideon's 40 years are counted from 1258 BC, the start of the Midianite 7 years.

chronologies.date: 2759d AM, 1245 BC (Gideon called and victorious; land at rest 40 years)

Jordan, From Creation to Solomon (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2, Biblical Horizons, Oct. 2001), ch. 11 "The Era of the Judges and the Reign of Saul", p. 52

chronologies.date: "2747 - End of Midianite oppression, beginning of Gideon's 40-year judgeship (Jud. 8:28)."
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "Chronology and Kings (II)," Biblical Chronology 3:8 (August 1991), section "The Judges", summary list
chronologies.note: 1991 scheme, superseded by Jordan himself in 2001 (Studies in Biblical Chronology No. 2 dates the whole judges sequence 26 years later because he there ends the 300 years of Judg 11:26 when Ammon took the villages, AM 2860, not at Jephthah's victory). BC 5:2: "Gideon delivered Israel in 2747, however, in time for the sabbath of 2748."
